## Why this matters
PR #251 was merged to `main` on 2026-06-14 without closing its R81 audit findings. This issue tracks the outstanding follow-up work. Features are behind `EXPO_PUBLIC_FF_COMMUNITY_SEARCH` and `EXPO_PUBLIC_FF_COMMUNITY_WEARABLE_PROMPTS` (both default-OFF) so there is no production blast radius today, but the PR is not R81-clean and cannot be flag-flipped until findings are closed.

## What's required
- [ ] **F1 (P1)** `CommunityVoiceNoteDetail` screen is absent — `voice_note_transcript` search results navigate to `CommunityThread` with a voice-note ID — `src/screens/community/CommunityFindScreen.tsx:80-86` — fix: build and register `CommunityVoiceNoteDetail`; route `voice_note_transcript` results with `voiceNoteId` param, not `postId`
- [ ] **F2 (P1)** D5B γ server-evaluated flags absent — search/wearable prompts remain local Expo env gates with no `GET /me/feature-flags` implementation — `src/config/featureFlags.ts` — fix: implement D5B γ: mobile API client + hook for `/me/feature-flags`; server-filter search result kinds accordingly
- [ ] **F3 (P2)** Missing flag-off static pins for `communitySearch` and `communityWearablePrompts` route gates — no `communitySearchFlagOff.test.ts` or `coachCommunityWearablePromptsFlagOff.test.ts` — fix: add both static pin files
- [ ] **F4 (P2)** No mobile telemetry emit sites for search submit/result-tap or wearable generate/dismiss/act-on — across PR #251 production files — fix: add `track(...)` calls with bounded payloads; add analytics event constant pins
- [ ] **F5 (P2)** Issue #255 "Already resolved" section falsely marks absent work as complete — `https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/issues/255` — fix: correct issue #255's checklist to accurately reflect current `main` state
- [ ] **F6 (P2)** No dedicated screen-level tests for `CommunityFindScreen` or `CommunityWearablePromptsScreen` — `src/screens/community/__tests__/` — fix: add screen-level tests for both screens
- [ ] **N1 (P2)** `CommunityWearablePromptsScreen` starts coach-only prompt hooks before flag, role, and `clientId` guards are resolved — `src/screens/community/CommunityWearablePromptsScreen.tsx:64-74,141-196` — fix: add explicit `enabled` guard to `useWearablePrompts` combining flag + role + clientId + workspaceId; add screen test asserting zero API calls under flag-off/non-coach/missing-client states
- [ ] **N2 (P2)** Dismiss and mark-acted-on mutation failures are caught and swallowed with no rendered error state — `src/screens/community/CommunityWearablePromptsScreen.tsx:84-111,229-235` — fix: wire `dismiss.isError` and `actOn.isError` into rendered error UI with retry affordance; add screen tests for rejected mutations
- [ ] **F7 (P3)** `SearchBar` clear button icon is 18dp with `hitSlop={8}` and no `minWidth`/`minHeight` — `src/components/community/SearchBar.tsx:49-61` — fix: ensure effective touch target meets 44/48dp minimum
- [ ] **F8 (P3)** `CommunityFindScreen` navigates to `CommunityLessonDetail`/`CommunityEventDetail` without checking dependent `communityClassroom`/`communityEvents` flags — `src/screens/community/CommunityFindScreen.tsx:87-96` — fix: guard classroom/event result routing against dependent route flags until server filtering makes those kinds impossible when disabled

## Already resolved
Pre-merge audit + post-merge re-audit complete. Findings list above is verified against current `main`.
